title: Approach to arthritis and synovial fluid analysis

steps.tx: **Arthritis** is joint inflammation with pain, swelling and warmth in many patients. **Monoarthritis** affects 1 joint while polyarthritis affects many joints in these patients. **Symmetric small joint** polyarthritis favours hands and feet in rheumatoid disease. Duration, pattern and associated features narrow the diagnosis in every case.

steps.tx: **Synovial fluid** analysis is mandatory in acute monoarthritis in these patients.
